articles.summary: HOUSTON, March 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. (Nasdaq: PAA) and Plains GP Holdings (Nasdaq: PAGP) (collectively, "Plains") today provided an update on the expected timing for completion of the Canadian NGL business divestiture to Keyera Corp.
articles.title: Plains All American Pipeline and Plains GP Holdings Provide Updated Timing for Completion of Sale of NGL Business
